flow: Win-back: Ridgeview, 14 days since the core action (created a report)
objective: Build a 5-touch automated win-back flow for users who completed onboarding but haven't created a report in 14 days

trigger.definition: 14 days without created a report (feature_used where feature = reports), measured from each person's own last feature_used; the daily entry job pushes core_action_lapsed_14d once per lapse
trigger.source_object: warehouse track_events (postgres) via the cohort entry query, pushed to Customer.io as the custom event core_action_lapsed_14d

re_entry.description: allowed after the person leaves the flow

entry_filters.condition: completed onboarding (onboarding_step_completed where step_index = 3) at least once
clicked or replied to any email in the last 90 days (opens do not count: privacy proxies inflate them)

ongoing_filters.condition: has not done feature_used where feature = reports since entering
can receive email marketing (subscribed, not bounced, not sunset-suppressed)

suppressions: unsubscribed from marketing email, or hard bounced
marked any message as spam (complaint), ever
sunset-suppressed (lcm_sunset is true); only a fresh opt-in lifts it
currently in a higher-priority flow (by the frequency policy's flow_priority: billing, cart, post-purchase first)
received a re-permission ask from any flow in the last 180 days

holdout.assignment: persistent, by user: bucket = first 7 hex digits of md5(user_id || ':ridgeview_winback_14d') mod 100; bucket < 15 is the holdout, computed in the daily queue query and pushed on the trigger event as in_holdout; holdout members enter, then exit at holdout_split, so both arms are the same population
holdout.sizing: about 28 entrants a month (DEMO DATA), 17.5% return within 30 days with no flow (DEMO DATA), 25% relative lift (4.4 pts) worth acting on: 781 holdout entrants at 15%, 186.0 months of entries plus the 30-day outcome window, so the read lands about 186.9 months after launch (engine/measurement/stats.py feasible --entries-per-month 28 --holdout 0.15 --baseline 0.1746 --mde-rel 0.25 --outcome-window-days 30)

frequency.cap: at most 3 email/sms/push message(s) per week across flows (the workspace message limit)

branch.condition: in_holdout is true (event property from the daily entry job)

steps.message: value reminder: Remind them of the one outcome Ridgeview gave them, tied to what they last did, with one link that lets them create a report again. No offer.
friction removal: Name the most common reason people stop at this point and remove it: a template, a two-minute path, or a reply to a person.
whats new: One change in Ridgeview since they were last active that makes it easier to create a report. Show it; do not list features. Queued for the next session; expires after 3 days.
social proof: How a customer like them uses Ridgeview to create a report: one specific, true example.
repermission: Ask plainly whether they still want these messages, with one button to stay. Say what happens if they do nothing.

steps.condition: no click on the re-permission email and no feature_used since entering
steps.message: Set lcm_sunset = true: suppressed from marketing, record kept, lifted only by a fresh opt-in

exit.goal: created a report (feature_used where feature = reports)

measurement.primary_metric: created a report (feature_used where feature = reports) within 30 days of entry, treatment vs holdout, both arms counted from their entry date
measurement.read_after: not inside 12 months at this volume (it would take about 187 months): keep the holdout, report against a pre/post baseline, and label every result directional
guardrails: spam complaint rate per send below 0.1% (Gmail's target; 0.3% is its hard limit)
unsubscribe rate per send, against the 90-day median for your lifecycle sends; pause a touch running above twice it

data_dependencies.name: onboarding_step_completed (step_index=3)
data_dependencies.note: qualifies a person for the flow; 708 events from 324 people; property step_index filled on 100% of events, 158 match 3

data_dependencies.name: feature_used (feature=reports)
data_dependencies.note: the core action: entry clock, exit and primary metric; 915 events from 209 people; property feature filled on 100% of events, 242 match reports

data_dependencies.name: email
data_dependencies.note: address for every email touch; users.email filled 100%

data_dependencies.name: session_started
data_dependencies.note: in-app messages show at the next session

data_dependencies.name: in_holdout
data_dependencies.note: set by the daily entry job on the pushed event; schedule the job before launch

data_dependencies.name: lcm_flow_entries
data_dependencies.note: the ledger (outbox) of entries; create it once with cohort/job/ledger_<dialect>.sql

data_dependencies.name: lcm_sunset
data_dependencies.note: suppression flag the sunset step writes; create the property in the platform before launch
